description: List all formula errors and model errors in a workbook, grouped by error, detail and origin (the cell where the error arose). Errors saved in the file are recalculated to find their origin and detail. Results are scoped to a sheet or range when provided, and truncated per group when the default cell limit is exceeded.

max.description: Max cells listed per formula-error group (default 50).

range.description: Restrict to a range, e.g. 'Sheet1!B2:D10' or 'B2:D10' (resolved against the default/first sheet). Takes precedence over 'sheet' if both are given.

sheet.description: Restrict to a single sheet by name.

name: listErrors
